newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close with losses at settlement end.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close with losses at settlement end.

text.p: Delhi shares ended with losses on Friday, the last day of the current settlement, as speculators squared their positions, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index dropped 9.58 points, closing at 725.86 points.
Traders said buying was slow ahead of the budget for 1997/98 (April-March), which is scheduled to be presented to parliament on February 28.
"Lack of any speculative buying, coupled with pre-budget hesitancy, has adversely affected the market's sentiment," said Manoj Aggarwal of brokers Multiple Investments.
But speculators drove up cement maker ACC's shares, which closed 17.50 rupees higher at 1,459.
Reliance Industries lost 5.35 rupees, closing at 262.40.
State Bank of India dropped 3.15 rupees to 282.15.
Larsen and Toubro ended 4.20 rupees lower at 236.50.
